🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL regime. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive (Energy, Communication, Technology); confirmation: very narrow sector breadth alongside mixed leadership (some large-cap tech strength but many mega-caps divergent), Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.59%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +7.70%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +11.89% | 1M: +19.32%) ABOVE TREND. Communication strength driven by NFLX (1W: +17.24% | 1M: +24.06%) ABOVE TREND. Technology shows pockets of strength: INTU (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND and NOW (1W: +10.14% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Staples weak: EL (1W: -14.06% | 1M: -17.29%) BELOW TREND, PM (1W: -9.49% | 1M: -4.12%) BELOW TREND. Materials and Financials also lag: NEM (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -0.70%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTU (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND, NFLX (1W: +17.24% | 1M: +24.06%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +11.90%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +12.31% | 1M: -3.30%) RECOVERY, VLO (1W: +11.89% | 1M: +19.32%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: EL (1W: -14.06% | 1M: -17.29%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -14.37% | 1M: -9.15%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -11.49% | 1M: -6.43%) BELOW TREND, RCL (1W: -11.25% | 1M: -13.25%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -10.09% | 1M: -6.59%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Staples, Autos and select Industrials/Tech.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTU (1W: +18.35%), NFLX (1W: +17.24%), DOW (1W: +14.11%), NOW (1W: +10.14%), VLO (1W: +11.89%). Note major divergence: multiple large caps show 1W vs 1M mismatch (AMZN, META, NVDA pattern) — MAJOR DIVERGENCE, so suppress strong directional bets and watch for trend confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed technical picture: AAPL (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -3.32%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +0.10%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +1.66%) CORRECTION, INTU (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND; sector 1W: +1.77% | 1M: -2.16% (24 stocks) — rotation within tech, narrow leaders.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials weakening overall: JPM (1W: -4.11% | 1M: -6.77%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: +0.98% | 1M: -2.58%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +1.92% | 1M: -4.73%) RECOVERY; sector 1W: -3.86% | 1M: -5.07% (20 stocks) — breadth negative.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed / slightly defensive tilt: UNH (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +1.62%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -1.58% | 1M: +3.35%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -3.79% | 1M: -1.85%) BELOW TREND, PFE (1W: -1.81% | 1M: +3.26%) CORRECTION; sector 1W: -1.69% | 1M: +1.24% (17 stocks).

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Energy and high-momentum Tech names (VLO, CVX, INTU, NOW, ADBE) and monitor RECOVERY setups (PLTR, AMZN, META) for confirmation; reduce exposure to clearly BELOW TREND Financials and Staples (GS, EL, PM). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; be selective given MAJOR DIVERGENCE.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +17.24% | 1M: +24.06%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +18.35% | 1M: +7.53%) ABOVE TREND — watch for follow-through. BEARISH: GS (1W: -9.60% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -14.06% | 1M: -17.29%) BELOW TREND — downside momentum to monitor.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.31% | 1M: +11.59%) and Communication (1W: +2.82% | 1M: +7.03%) — momentum to watch. BEARISH: Financials (1W: -3.86% | 1M: -5.07%) and Consumer Staples (1W: -4.72% | 1M: -1.58%) — monitor for widening weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +1.66%) CORRECTION — needs sustained 1W reversal to signal renewal; AAPL (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -3.32%) BELOW TREND — failure to stabilize would increase downside risk; CVX (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +7.70%) ABOVE TREND — sustained strength would confirm sector rotation.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
EA (+90): large buyout chatter — price action has been strong in Communication (NFLX up), cross-ref: confirming sector momentum. ABT (+80): FDA CardioMEMS approval headline — healthcare context positive but monitor JNJ/UNH mixed price action for confirmation. CSCO (+60): $2.1B AI orders headline — tech/infra catalyst that aligns with pockets of tech strength; watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AMD (-60): export/permit scrutiny headline — watch for pressure on semis and LRCX; LRCX (1W: -10.09% | 1M: -6.59%) BELOW TREND confirms downside. PM (-60): earnings miss headline — PM (1W: -9.49% | 1M: -4.12%) BELOW TREND confirms bearish sentiment. MSFT (-50): antitrust headline versus MSFT (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +0.10%) ABOVE TREND — watch for divergence between news and price.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed / no clear leadership. Energy and selective Tech names showing relative strength (VLO ABOVE TREND, INTU ABOVE TREND, NOW ABOVE TREND). Key risk: MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large caps (AMZN/META/NVDA patterns) and mixed news flow (AMD, LRCX negative vs EA/ABT positive) — monitor for confirmation before increasing exposure.
